tasks.short: Tell relatives the circumstances of the death.

steps.what: Read which circumstances of death may be shared.
Provide information to relatives of the deceased.
Hear questions from the relatives.
Accept the note of information provided.
File that note after the relatives were told.

tasks.design: The coroner decides what may be said, tells the relatives, and hears their questions. A note of what was said is filed only after that conversation. No message is sent in their place, and the call is not recorded.
tasks.previous_blocker: What a relative can bear, and what the investigation can disclose, changes with the person.
tasks.enabler_now: The case file can hold a short note of a conversation the coroner has already had.
tasks.still_hard: The relative may be a witness, and the wrong detail can harm them or the investigation.
tasks.human_edge: The coroner speaks to the relative. A template does not.
tasks.altitude: Telling relatives stays a conversation the coroner has. The file holds only a note of what they already said.

reach.task: Hear the circumstances from the coroner
reach.learn: The coroner chose what could be said

evidence.claim: A note can record what the coroner already told a relative. It cannot tell them.

Assigning cause or manner of death, certifying a death, and arranging care for a child are determinations the coroner makes. A tool does not make them. National rules decide who may certify a death. EU data-protection rules cover medical details and living relatives. The file stores only what the coroner recorded, and interviews are not stored as audio.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the coroner is ready to speak to a relative and ends when the note of that conversation is filed. Determining the cause is a separate task. The call is not recorded.
The fields are case id, who was told, and the points the coroner actually said. The coroner produces them from the conversation. A point they did not say is not added.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on the conversation. Only the note of it is shorter.
Upkeep is keeping the list of points that may be shared, which the coroner still edits.
unknowns: Which circumstances may be told before the investigation is closed.
Whether a relative must be told in person rather than by telephone.
research_questions: Which circumstances may be told before the investigation closes?
Must a relative be told in person?

already_counted.description: Providing information to relatives stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the list of points that may be shared

approvals.approved_version: note of information the coroner provided to relatives after the conversation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the conversation is rarely written down at all, the low end is the reading, the conversation, and the hearing, which stay. Nothing is sent to a relative by a tool. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Remove bodies and arrange morgue transport.

steps.what: Supervise removal of bodies from death scenes.
Use the proper equipment and supplies.
Arrange transportation to morgues.
Note which morgues received the bodies.

tasks.design: The coroner supervises the removal, uses the equipment, and arranges the morgue. A short note names the morgue afterwards. No vehicle is dispatched by a tool.
tasks.previous_blocker: The scene, the access, and the condition of the body decide how the removal is done.
tasks.enabler_now: The destination can be written once after the coroner has arranged it.
tasks.still_hard: Moving a body is physical, and the wrong handling damages evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The coroner supervises the removal and chooses the morgue. A roster does not.
tasks.altitude: Removing the body and arranging the morgue stay with the coroner. The note only names the morgue they already chose.

reach.task: Move a body the coroner is supervising

evidence.claim: A one-line destination can be stored after the coroner has arranged the morgue. The removal stays physical.

Assigning cause or manner of death, certifying a death, and arranging care for a child are determinations the coroner makes. A tool does not make them. National rules decide who may certify a death. EU data-protection rules cover medical details and living relatives. The file stores only what the coroner recorded, and interviews are not stored as audio.

assumptions: The workflow starts at the scene and ends when the morgue note is written. The examination is a separate task.
The fields are case id, morgue name, and the time the coroner arranged transport. The coroner produces them by arranging it. No route is calculated.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on the removal and the arrangement. The note is a small remainder.
Upkeep is keeping the list of morgues this office uses.
unknowns: Which morgues this office is allowed to use.
Which removals a technician does under supervision.
research_questions: Which morgues may this office use?
Which removals does a technician do under supervision?

already_counted.description: Supervising removal of bodies stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the list of morgues this office uses

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the morgue is always the same, the note shrinks and the low end is the removal, the equipment, and the telephone call, which stay. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inquire into the death and establish identity.

steps.what: Inquire into the cause of the death.
Inquire into the manner and circumstances.
Establish the identities of deceased persons.
Compare documents used to establish identity.
Accept the identities of the deceased persons.
File the identities the coroner accepted.

tasks.design: The coroner inquires into cause, manner, and circumstances, and establishes who the person was by comparing documents. The file stores only the identities they accepted. No match score is produced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Identity and cause are judgements on incomplete records, and a near name is not the person.
tasks.enabler_now: An identity the coroner has already established can be stored without retyping the name.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong identity attaches the death, the property, and the relatives to the wrong person.
tasks.human_edge: The coroner establishes the identity. A name search does not.
tasks.altitude: The inquiry and the identification stay with the coroner. The file holds the identities they accepted after comparing the documents.

reach.task: Record an identity the coroner established

evidence.claim: A case file can store an identity the coroner established after comparing documents. It does not match people.

Assigning cause or manner of death, certifying a death, and arranging care for a child are determinations the coroner makes. A tool does not make them. National rules decide who may certify a death. EU data-protection rules cover medical details and living relatives. The file stores only what the coroner recorded, and interviews are not stored as audio.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the notes and the documents are in hand and ends when the accepted identity is on the case file. The certificate is a separate task.
The fields are case id, the name the coroner established, and the document they relied on. The coroner produces the name. A search hit is not copied in as the identity.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on the inquiry and the identification. Only the copy of an accepted name is shorter.
Upkeep is keeping the document types the office accepts as identity evidence.
unknowns: Which documents are enough to establish an identity in this office.
Who may see the identity before relatives are told.
research_questions: Which documents are enough to establish an identity here?
Who may see the identity before relatives are told?

already_counted.description: Establishing identities stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the document types accepted as identity evidence

approvals.approved_version: identities the coroner established and then accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the identity is already on the register and the coroner only confirms it, the low end is the inquiry and the confirmation, which stay. No score is used either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Preserve objects and property at the death.

steps.what: Observe objects related to the death.
Preserve medication containers and suicide notes.
Preserve other personal property at the scene.
Review the list of preserved objects.
Record the accepted list of objects.

tasks.design: The coroner observes and preserves the objects, including medication containers and suicide notes, then reviews the list. The file stores that list. It does not read the note or name a medication.
tasks.previous_blocker: The objects are physical, and a suicide note has to be preserved intact, not summarised.
tasks.enabler_now: A list the coroner has reviewed can be stored without a second inventory.
tasks.still_hard: A medication name read wrongly, or a note paraphrased, changes the later inquiry.
tasks.human_edge: The coroner sees the object and decides it is kept. The list does not interpret it.
tasks.altitude: Preserving the objects stays physical. The record is the list the coroner reviewed, not a reading of the notes.

reach.task: Use the object list the coroner reviewed
reach.learn: The objects were preserved by the coroner

evidence.claim: A list can name objects the coroner has already preserved. It does not read a note or a label for them.

Assigning cause or manner of death, certifying a death, and arranging care for a child are determinations the coroner makes. A tool does not make them. National rules decide who may certify a death. EU data-protection rules cover medical details and living relatives. The file stores only what the coroner recorded, and interviews are not stored as audio.

assumptions: The workflow starts at the scene and ends when the reviewed list is on the case file. The inquiry that uses those objects is a separate task.
The fields are case id, object type, and where it was kept. The coroner produces them by looking. The text of a note is not copied by a tool.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on observing and preserving. Only the copy of a reviewed list is shorter.
Upkeep is keeping the object-type labels the office uses.
unknowns: Whether medication names are typed by the coroner or left for a pharmacist.
Where suicide notes are stored, and who may read them.
research_questions: Who types the medication name, the coroner or a pharmacist?
Where are suicide notes stored, and who may read them?

already_counted.description: Preserving medication containers stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the object-type labels the office uses

approvals.approved_version: list of objects the coroner preserved and then reviewed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the list is written once, at the scene, into the case file, the second copy disappears and the low end is the observation and the preserving, which stay. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Telling relatives, removing the body, and establishing identity stay with the coroner. Objects, including medication containers and suicide notes, are preserved by them. The file holds a note, a destination, an identity, or a list they have already accepted.
reach: A relative hears the circumstances from the coroner
A registrar records an identity the coroner established
skills_to_grow: Telling a relative before any note is filed
Establishing identity without a match score
Preserving a note without having it read by a tool
role.ambitious_version: Every identity on the file is one the coroner established, and every object list names things they preserved.
